## Summary

Describe the changes made in this pull request and why they are needed.

## Related Issue

- Fixes: #(issue number)  <!-- e.g. Fixes: #123 -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update

## How to test

Provide clear instructions to reproduce and validate the changes locally.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] I have added necessary documentation (if appropriate)
- [ ] Linting and formatting are passing
- [ ] I have updated CHANGELOG.md if the change is notable

## Screenshots (if applicable)

Add screenshots or animated GIFs to help explain visual changes.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything specific you'd like reviewers to focus on.
